prompt: arc after the mixing pass: a twin of arc to A/B, same notes and sounds, mixed as a scene

requests.ask: add a -mixed version of arc, arrival, breakwater, cutwork, hunted and machine without altering the originals

changes.why: size 1.3 fade .35 damping 6500: one room, each part's space as its send
the kit was the mix (1.2 dB under it, 1.2% of samples clipping); it still peaks at full scale alone, so the rest came up to it instead
under the kick, ducked with a written 120 ms recovery (duckDepth .35)
the piano hook was 18 dB under the mix; now 8, foreground, a little right with a phrase-shaped velocity line
glockenspiel>vibraphone the bell twin measured 56 dB under the mix (inaudible): the glockenspiel sample is too quiet to place; a vibraphone at register .7 sits at 12, set left
the pad was 9 dB under the mix in the original; wide, a little left, lightly ducked, now background

requests.ask: use the new mixing tools on the -mixed songs: impulse-response rooms, humanize, compressor, depth words

changes.why: synthetic>plate the generated plate impulse (samples/user/rooms, 1.8 s, 15 ms pre-delay): the reverb has early reflections and a real pre-delay now, one convolver for every part
the hook is played (12 ms, phrase-correlated), not exact; velocity line kept
closer: space down, weight up (.58); depth by tone, not level alone

requests.ask: arc-mixed needs some sweep between sections, or maybe riser

changes.why: sweep 0>2 the filter closes over the last two bars so the verse opens fresh
sweep 0>2 same closing sweep into the lift
riser 0>2 white-noise riser over the same two bars as the sweep, the one boundary that earns it
impact none>bd a hit on the drop downbeat to land the riser
